title: Broadcast Bias
description: Add a bias vector to a batch of feature vectors using broadcasting.
problemStatement:
Write code that:
1. Creates a tensor `batch` of shape (8, 10) filled with ones. This simulates a batch of 8 samples, each with 10 features.
2. Creates a bias tensor `bias` of shape (10,) containing the values 0.1, 0.2, ..., 1.0 (use `torch.linspace`).
3. Adds the bias to the batch (each sample gets the same bias added).
4. Prints the first sample after addition to verify it worked.

The output must be the first row of the resulting tensor.
hints: Broadcasting will automatically add the (10,) bias to each row of (8,10).
solutionCode:
import torch

batch = torch.ones(8, 10)
bias = torch.linspace(0.1, 1.0, steps=10)
result = batch + bias
print(result[0])
